svg.title: Comparison of diffusion inversion and editing methods: DDIM, NTI/NPI, DirectINV, SPDINV and DCI
svg.desc: Editable native SVG reconstruction of the supplied figure. Base frames f01-f05 correspond to panels (a)-(e). Each panel inventories denoising, reconstruction, inversion, reference, editing, interaction and optimization pathways with labeled latent variables and U-Net/image-reference elements. No SAM assets are attached, so all visible content is constructed in SVG.

g.desc: Panel (a) DDIM: top gray denoising chain Z_T to Z_0, magenta D_noi loop on left, red D_rec loop on right, purple inversion path from Z_0 downward/left, and green reconstruction path along bottom.

Panel (c) DirectINV: gray denoising chain at top, red/magenta outer denoising and reconstruction loops, purple inversion path, green reconstruction path and vertical optimization interactions between corresponding purple/green nodes and from gray Z0 to green Z0.
Panel (b) NTI, NPI: similar to DDIM with added blue reference path along the bottom and yellow interaction arrows linking green and blue paths at corresponding latent states.

Panel (d) SPDINV: U-Net above the gray denoising chain, magenta denoising loop, red reconstruction loop, purple inversion, green reconstruction, and brown optimization lines/loops from the U-Net to latent states.

Panel (e) DCI: upper image reference fixed-point optimization sub-frame with photo, encoder, U-Net, frozen indicators, pink/lavender loss chain and dashed connection to the lower diffusion graph. Lower section contains gray denoising path, magenta/green/purple latent paths, optimization loops, red reconstruction, and an orange editing path with high edit fidelity.
Legend mapping colored circles and arrows to reconstruction, editing, inversion, reference, interaction and optimization paths.
